title: When the delta is fake: Pass-bar design for agent evaluation
description:
Technical note on pass-bar design for agent-evaluation tasks. Releases three public tasks covering event-sourced repair, systems contracts, and distribution-shift reporting. Each task includes named starter failure modes, an oracle solution, and a verifier that recomputes scores from artifacts rather than trusting self-reported fields.

Includes a distribution-shift case study (ranking AUROC invariance under mean-only shift; train-site label shortcut that flips at evaluation) and a scored staged-fail transcript with an explicit positive/negative rubric.

Positioned relative to Terminal-Bench, Harbor, and Inspect. Synthetic fixtures. Methodological scope; not a model leaderboard.

Reproduction: pytest -q -p no:randomly tasks/*/tests; python3 tasks/site-shift-meter/solution/train_and_eval.py.
